rationale.rules-based-checks: Executable specifications and deterministic tests form the proposed quality gate.
rationale.ai-review: Experiments expose correlated, confident failures and bound AI review’s legitimate role.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Frames accelerated generation as shifting the bottleneck to verification and auditing.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes AI-review-first pipelines as structurally circular without external specifications.
